description: This bar chart, titled "Recall@10", illustrates the performance metric Recall@10 for four different methods or configurations: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The horizontal axis displays these four categories in the order listed, while the vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 on a linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar labeled "Ours" is colored orange and reaches a value of approximately 0.35. The bar for "- critiquing" is blue and has a value of approximately 0.30. The bar for "- scoring" is also blue and has a value of approximately 0.17. The bar for "- ranking" is blue and has a value of approximately 0.25. The bars are presented in a grouped format, with each bar representing the performance of its respective method. The chart does not indicate any sorting of the bars by value or any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
